title: Marine Propellers & Shafting
description: Large-diameter, complex blade curvature, tapered shaft with keyway, flanged couplings
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 2 (CP-Ti) offers excellent seawater corrosion resistance (no pitting after years of immersion) at lower cost than Grade 5. Grade 5 for high-thrust propellers.
Form: Large propellers are investment cast or fabricated from welded plates. Shafting uses forged bar stock for strength and grain flow.
engineeringTrends: Process: TIG welding of built-up propellers
comparisonNotes: Standards: ASTM B367 Grade C-2 (cast) / ASTM B348 Grade 2 (shaft), annealed, 100% FPI + balancing
